_comment_about_this_file: Claude Desktop / Claude Code MCP config for walmart-listing-mcp.
Same JSON shape works for both clients; only the file path differs.
Claude Code            : .mcp.json at the root of any project that should see the server
1. Replace <ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_REPO> with the absolute path of this repo on your machine.
2. Replace <NODE_PATH> with the absolute path to your node binary, OR just write "node"
if it's on PATH. Find it via: which node (Mac/Linux) or where node (Windows).
3. Fill in WALMART_CLIENT_ID / WALMART_CLIENT_SECRET from https://developer.walmart.com/
4. Keep WALMART_SANDBOX as "true" until you have run docs/PRODUCTION_VALIDATION.md
against your sandbox at least once. Production writes are real money.
5. Delete this _comment_about_this_file block before saving — the JSON parser
of your MCP client may or may not tolerate it.
